newsitem.title: PERU: Phillips to invest $47mln in Peru oil field.
newsitem.headline: Phillips to invest $47mln in Peru oil field.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Peru Ltd, a subsidiary of U.S. oil company Phillips Petroleum Co, plans to invest at least $46.5 million in exploration of an oil field in southern Peru, the government said Thursday.
Phillips signed a contract Jan 30 with state-run Perupetro SA to explore and exploit crude and products from the "Lot 82" field in Peru's southern jungle area, Perupetro said in a release.
Under the terms of the contract, Phillips will pay a cash royalty on a sliding scale according to the commercial value of products sold from the area.
The contract was the first signed by Perupetro this year and the 36th since the government body started offering exploration contracts to private companies four years ago.
